title: 按先 soft 后 hard 策略收敛门禁并执行全链路回归

requirements: 执行 2 阶段门禁策略: [soft gate collect, selective hard gate enforce]
覆盖 5 组关键回归命令: [pytest baseline, workflow decision, gateway contract, desktop targeted vitest, desktop test:ci]
生成 1 份收敛结果标准: [all critical chains pass with backward compatibility]
acceptance: soft gate 观测完成且无新增关键失败: verify by `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_workflow_engine.py -k "decision" -q && pytest tests/unit/mcp/test_gateway_stream.py -k "contract" -q`

hard gate 关键三组通过: verify by `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_workflow_engine.py -k "decision" -q && pytest tests/unit/mcp/test_gateway_stream.py -k "contract" -q && npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/api/client.test.ts src/components/EvaluationPanel.test.tsx`
全链路基线通过: verify by `pytest tests/unit tests/integration -m "not e2e" --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=80 --junitxml=pytest-baseline.xml && npm --prefix desktop run test:ci`

artifacts.contains: soft gate first, selective hard gate

pre_analysis.action: Load context package for artifact paths and smart context
Load role analyses from context-package.json (progressive loading by priority)
Verify pytest and vitest command matrix from CI workflow

implementation_approach.title: 执行 soft gate 收敛
implementation_approach.description: 先运行 soft gate 关键命令收集风险收敛状态
modification_points: 执行 2 组 soft 命令: [workflow decision, gateway contract]
logic_flow: 运行 workflow decision 回归
运行 gateway contract 回归

implementation_approach.title: 启用 selective hard gate
implementation_approach.description: 仅对高风险三组断言启用 hard fail
modification_points: 执行 3 组 hard 命令: [workflow decision, gateway contract, desktop parser/evaluation]
logic_flow: 失败则回滚到 soft 阶段策略

implementation_approach.title: 执行全链路基线回归
implementation_approach.description: 运行 pytest baseline 与 desktop test:ci 作为最终收敛验证
modification_points: 执行 2 条基线命令: [pytest baseline, desktop test:ci]
logic_flow: 运行 Python baseline 覆盖率门槛
运行 desktop CI 测试
